neighbours.label: Marks written units of mass, length, or volume after numerical quantities.
fire: Before loading, the technician recorded the spare battery's mass as 18 kg.
At the clinic, the rescued seal weighed 23 kilograms during its first examination.
For this shipment, the empty wooden crate weighs 36 pounds without its lid.
During inspection, the freight scale displayed a net weight of 145 lbs.
After the leak, the mechanic poured 1 gallon of coolant into the reservoir.
Along its widest edge, the replacement shelf measures 84 cm across.
Despite the detour, the cyclist completed the remaining 47 km before sunset.
После осмотра ветеринар записал в карточке, что масса молодой собаки составляет 12 кг.
quiet: After unloading, the technician described the spare battery as surprisingly heavy for its size.
During the examination, the rescued seal weighed twice as much as its younger companion.
Before dispatch, the empty wooden crate was weighed again without its lid.
On the freight scale, the net weight field displayed only the number 145.
Before refilling, the mechanic checked how much coolant remained in the reservoir.
On the inspection form, the shelf's width appeared as 84 under the measurement heading.
After the detour, the cyclist recorded the remaining distance as 47 in the route log.
Во время осмотра ветеринар отметил, что молодая собака стала заметно тяжелее после лечения.
